newsitem.title: USA: FDA says diet supplement could be deadly.
newsitem.headline: FDA says diet supplement could be deadly.

text.p: Consumers should steer clear of an herbal dietary supplement because it may cause severe heart problems and even death, the Food and Drug Administration said on Friday.

The FDA said a woman who recently took "Chomper," manufactured by Mount Shasta, California-based Arise and Shine company, developed an abnormal heart rate and heartblock, a potentially life-threatening condition.
"The agency has found that Chomper poses a potentially significant and unreasonable risk to public health," the FDA said in a news release.

Some substances in Chomper are found in poisonous plants and can cause a potentially fatal heartblock, "even in otherwise healthy individuals," the agency said. The product is promoted as an herbal laxative and "cleansing" agent that is used as part of Arise and Shine's "The Cleanse Thyself" diet regimen, the FDA said.
It has not been determined if other injuries have been caused by Chomper, the FDA said.
